name: anry
description: Give your agent your store's analyst. Anry watches your shop and ad spend, finds and prices revenue leaks, and serves the reports, evidence and ready-to-ship fixes behind every finding.

interface.longDescription:
Anry is the analyst a small ecommerce team cannot hire. It watches your store and your ad spend from the day you connect, with nothing to configure: on-site behavior, paid campaigns, every purchase. Statistical detectors find where revenue is slipping out, price each leak, and write the fix into dated reports your team reads each week.

This app gives ChatGPT the same picture, and the playbooks Anry's own analysts reason from. Ask where you are losing money, why a landing page underperforms, which campaigns waste spend, what visitors did this week, or what changed since June.

What ChatGPT can do:
- See what matters now: the opportunities on your dashboard, each typed, priced and backed by evidence
- Search the ledger: every dated report for a page, campaign, ad or question, plus the weekly brief journal
- Pull the evidence behind a claim: session journeys and replay facts, heatmaps, top pages, traffic sources, funnel metrics
- Read the week: which sessions are worth opening and which behaviours repeat across them
- Audit paid media: spend, attributed revenue and waste per campaign and ad, always in your store's currency
- Check setup: tracking, purchases, ad connections, store integrations
- Keep the record: read the site diary before diagnosing, and log what your team changed or learned
- Work across sites: agencies see every client site their account can access

Every tool reads, except one that appends a dated entry to your site diary. Nothing changes your store, your ad accounts, your settings, campaigns, goals or reports. Numbers are quoted exactly as your dashboard shows them.

Requires an Anry account with a connected site (anry.io). Works with Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop and any site via snippet.
interface.defaultPrompt: Where is my store losing money right now?

positive.description: Find and price the store's current revenue leaks
positive.prompt: Where is my store losing money right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_sites, then list_opportunities with the returned site_id, and answers with the current findings, each typed and priced in the store's own currency, figures quoted exactly as returned.

positive.description: Read the latest dated report and surface its suggestion
positive.prompt: Summarize my latest report and what I should do first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_reports, then get_report with a returned id. Quotes the dated document's figures verbatim and surfaces the report's suggested action.

positive.description: Break down pages and traffic sources
positive.prompt: What are my top pages and where does my traffic come from?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_top_pages and get_traffic_sources for the site and gives a readable breakdown with no fabricated metrics.

positive.description: Audit paid media spend for waste
positive.prompt: Which of my ad campaigns wasted spend recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_paid_waste_summary (and get_campaign_spend for detail), figures in the store's own currency. If the account has no connected ad platform, the tools return an empty result with an explanatory note and the model says so rather than inventing numbers.

positive.description: Record what the team changed: the one tool that writes
positive.prompt: We shipped a bigger Add to cart button on the product page yesterday. Log that in the site diary.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls record_diary_entry with kind 'change', the product page as subject and yesterday's date, then confirms the entry. It writes the diary and nothing else: no setting, campaign, goal or report changes, and nothing in the store or any ad account. A following list_diary_entries returns the new entry.

negative.description: General how-to about a third-party product; Anry holds no GA configuration and the plugin has nothing to add
negative.prompt: How do I set up Google Analytics 4 on my Shopify store?

negative.description: Store administration; the plugin reads analytics and writes only its own site diary, never the store
negative.prompt: Create a 10% discount code in my store.

negative.description: A to-do, not a fact. The diary records what happened, never an intention, so nothing should be written
negative.prompt: Remind me to redesign the checkout page next sprint.

publication.release_notes: First public release. The anry-bootstrap skill plus 23 tools over Anry's commerce intelligence: current opportunities and their evidence, the dated report ledger, session journeys, replay facts and notable sessions, heatmaps, traffic and funnel metrics, paid-media spend and waste, site setup status, the site diary, and the playbooks Anry's own analysts work from. Every tool reads except record_diary_entry, which appends a dated entry to your site diary and changes nothing else. OAuth 2.1 sign-in with your Anry account; access is evaluated per call against your own site memberships.
